about.title: Moving Businesses Forward.
about.text: Kasi Transport’s roots go back to 1996, and the business was established in 2005. Today we support businesses that need road transport for regular routes, individual deliveries and live productions.
about.clientsTitle: Trusted by businesses we move for

services.title: Transport Solutions for Your Business

items.title: Linehaul & Contract Logistics
items.text: Scheduled hub-to-hub transfers and recurring transport.

items.title: Commercial Transportation
items.text: Cargo deliveries and stock movements between business locations.

items.title: Event & Production Logistics
items.text: Equipment transport planned around venue access and production schedules.

items.title: Specialised Transportation
items.text: Transport enquiries for loads with specific vehicle or handling needs.

services.text: From scheduled linehaul to live production logistics, we move cargo and equipment across Peninsular Malaysia.

fleet.title: Our Fleet
fleet.text: We use our own trucks and work with independent transport partners. Tell us what you need to move, where it is going and when, and we will suggest the right vehicle.

more.title: Not sure which fits?
more.text: Tell us what you’re moving and where.
